description: PySedSim simulates daily water and sediment mass balances and hydropower in reservoir and river-channel networks. It includes stochastic scenarios and sediment-management options such as flushing, bypassing and dredging. The provider is FeralFlows. Coverage: The model is generic to user-specified river basins and operates at a daily time step. Dates and spatial network detail are supplied through model inputs. Access: Public repository documentation identifies XLSX and CSV inputs and CSV outputs, installation guidance and publications. No code or inputs were downloaded. Licence and cost: The repository identifies the BSD 2-Clause licence. Required software and external input data have separate conditions. Limitations: This is a screening mass-balance model, not a fine-scale sediment-transport solver. The README establishes publications and reuse, but no simulations were checked here. For simulation it supports comparison of reservoir siting, design and operating policies. Related resources: SedSim and PySedSim are distinct VBA and Python implementations. Neither has an existing catalogue record identified in this review.
